title: minuartia douglasii var. emarginata
intro: Minuartia douglasii var. emarginata, commonly known as Douglas' dwarf sandwort, is a type of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia douglasii var. emarginata include its ability to soothe sore throats, relieve congestion, and calm bronchial spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
